question: Monohybrid cross is the combining of two plants with ______ ​different versions of a trait.
solution:
The correct answer is __**two**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Two organisms **that have different variations at the same genetic locus are combined to form a **monohybrid cross**.
 
• In a monohybrid cross, **two **or more **mutations **at a single gene locus control the features being studied.
 
• After that, each parent is chosen to have the **desired characteristic **in **homozygosity**, or **true breeding (locus).**
 
• The **monohybrid ratio**, also known as the distribution of **second-generation (F2) offspring**, is often used to determine if a cross qualifies as a monohybrid cross. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Austrian monk** Gregor Mendel (1822–1884) **developed the basic principles of **heredity theory.**
 
• In his **monastery garden **from **1858 to 1866, **he **crossed garden peas **(Pisum sativum) and **studied **the **progeny**.
 
• The garden pea was chosen as the **experimental organism **because it was widely available, bred accurately for qualitative features, and allowed for controlled pollination.
 
• Mendel looked into **seven different **traits in pea plants, including:
 
 
• **seed texture **(round vs wrinkled).
 
• **seed color **(yellow vs green).
 
• **flower color **(white vs purple).
 
• **growth **habit (tall vs dwarf).
 
• **pod shape **(pinched or inflated).
 
• **pod color **(green vs yellow).
 
• **flower position **(axial or terminal).
